results.content: # HP SET Exam 2026 - Application Form (Released), Eligibility, Admit Card, Result. ## About HP SET 2026. The Himachal Pradesh Public Service Commission released the HP SET notification on January 3, 2026. The board has activated the HP SET application form 2026 on January 3, 2026. The last date to fill out the HP SET 2026 application form is January 30, 2026 till 11:59 PM. The Himachal Pradesh Public Service Commission (Authorized Agency) conducts the State Eligibility Test (SET) for determining the Eligibility for recruitment to the post(s) of Assistant Professor(s) in universities and colleges located within the State of Himachal Pradesh. Eligible candidates can fill the application form in online mode. The admit card is issued 5 days prior to the exam date to only those candidates who fill the application form successfully. HP SET Himachal Pradesh State Eligibility Test (session 2026). The HP SET application form was released by the examination authority in online mode on January 3, 2026.
